owner_rule: Owner 2026-10-07: this project must never take the whole box; always leave about 500 MB free for the owner's other projects (Hermes), their own conversations and the proxy (xray/hysteria). Budgets are planned against this file, never against the 3.9 GB total. Owner 2026-10-08: 3 agents and 1.2 GB per job were too strict; ceilings doubled to 6 and 2.4 GB, made to fit by compressing idle memory (zswap) and a second swap file, while the project's RAM limit (2.2 GB) and the 500 MB reserve stay. docs/local-vps-migration.zh.md
background_agents_note: Owner 2026-11-10 requests more parallel substantive research. Root raises the concurrency ceiling from6 to8 for two independent questions; the2200MiB project limit,500MiB reserve and existing admission checks remain binding. This is capacity, not a target to fill or a research stopping count.
units_note: MB = MiB; 2458 MB is run_capped's --mem 2.4G, the documented local job limit (1229 = 1.2G until 2026-10-08).
heavy_job_mb_note: An agent or job starts when the box has its start headroom free above the reserve (agent_admit_headroom_mb; for a job min(--mem, heavy_job_mb)) and research jobs hold less than research_max_mb by actual use. Inside the project the kernel then makes room by compressing idle memory (zswap); the governor keeps the reserve (memory_budget.py admit).
